title: Temporal Gunslinger
description:
Temporal Gunslinger is an action puzzle game where you have the power to redirect bullets mid-flight and rewind time to take down multiple foes in the blink of an eye. You follow the Revenant, an undead hitman tasked with slaying the Reaper's traitorous Heralds, and travel across time to chase them down to their hiding places.

Experience a story-rich 4-5 hour campaign where you will:

Have mastery over projectiles

Your bullets bend to your will. Set up impossible trickshots to thoroughly overwhelm your enemies. Unlock additional abilities that allow more complex tactics.

Control time as you desire

You possess the ability to rewind time, allowing you to correct your strategy with ease. Escape death by undoing the actions of your enemies.

Slay dangerous foes imbued with powerful abilities

You are not the only supernatural entity. The Heralds are a threat that necessitate clever use of your skills and powers. Experience dramatic boss encounters against unique characters.

Travel across differing time periods

Hunt down the Heralds in their original time period. Witness an eclectic assortment of environments. See a world transform and change over the course of a millennia.
description_short: Play as a supernatural gunslinger with the power to redirect bullets and rewind time in this action puzzle game. Travel across different time periods and slay the Reaper's traitorous Heralds. Achieve mastery over time and projectiles.
